title: EU AI Act — high-risk uses that need human oversight (Annex III), screened in a TEE

rules.question: Does the text ask to evaluate, rank, select, promote, dismiss, discipline or monitor a specific job candidate or employee, or to decide on their pay or tasks?
Does the text ask to assess a specific person's creditworthiness, credit score, or eligibility or price for life or health insurance?
Does the text ask to decide whether a specific person gets, keeps or loses a public benefit, healthcare or another essential service?
